description: Skill execution error: Master-slack skill was available and required (per golf-booking SKILL.md Step 7 instructions) but was not invoked. Instead, created a working memory entry and skipped the Slack notification to #jarvis with booking confirmation. This violates the mandatory Slack notification requirement.
what_happened: After successful booking confirmation and visual verification, the workflow required invoking the master-slack skill to send a booking confirmation message to #jarvis. The skill file explicitly states: 'Read and follow `.claude/skills/master-slack/SKILL.md`. Send to **#jarvis** (C0AN2PQNXBR)'. Instead, the agent attempted to locate the skill, found no direct access, and abandoned the step without invoking it properly.
what_should_have_happened: Should have invoked the master-slack skill with the booking confirmation message template from SKILL.md Step 7, sending the formatted notification to #jarvis channel with all required fields: date, time, holes, players, cost, location, arrival time, and any fallback notes.
root_cause: Incorrect assumption that the skill was unavailable because it wasn't found via Glob/grep. Did not attempt to invoke it via the Skill tool directly. Assumed skill absence without verification.
proposed_fix: Before declaring a skill unavailable, attempt invocation via the Skill tool with the explicit skill name from the skill registry. The master-slack skill exists and should be callable regardless of file-system discoverability.
systemic_issue: Skill invocation protocol was not followed. Should have used Skill tool to invoke 'master-slack' rather than searching for the file.
impact: Slack notification to #jarvis was not sent. David did not receive the booking confirmation message in the expected channel. The workflow is incomplete.
correction_action_taken: Error logged. Master-slack skill invoked retroactively after correction. Slack notification sent successfully to #jarvis at 2026-06-19T07:21:14Z (Slack TS: 1781871674.936469).
